tagline: Pick the day, the time, and where we should go. I will be there.

movie.name: Movie Date
movie.blurb: Lights down, popcorn up, and a film we can talk about on the way home.

inox-south-city.name: INOX South City Mall
inox-south-city.note: Big screens, easy food nearby, and a mall stroll after.

pvr-quest.name: PVR Quest Mall
pvr-quest.note: Central, pretty, and perfect for a Park Circus evening.

inox-city-centre.name: INOX City Centre 1
inox-city-centre.note: Comfortable seating and lots of post-movie dinner options.

nandan.name: Nandan
nandan.note: For a quieter, more cinematic Kolkata kind of date.

star-theatre.name: Star Theatre
star-theatre.note: Old-world theatre energy in North Kolkata.

cafe.name: Cafe Date
cafe.blurb: Slow coffee, shared dessert, and nowhere we have to rush.

flurys.name: Flurys
flurys.note: Classic rum balls, breakfast, and Park Street people-watching.

indian-coffee-house.name: Indian Coffee House
indian-coffee-house.note: Adda, history, and filter coffee in a room that never sleeps.

sienna.name: Sienna Store & Cafe
sienna.note: Pretty plates, plants, and a South Kolkata favourite.

mrs-magpie.name: Mrs Magpie
mrs-magpie.note: Pastries, tea, and a soft afternoon.

dollys-tea.name: Dolly's Tea Shop
dollys-tea.note: Legendary teas and a uniquely Kolkata pause.

oxford-cha-bar.name: Cha Bar at Oxford Bookstore
oxford-cha-bar.note: Books upstairs, tea downstairs, conversation in between.

dinner.name: Dinner Date
dinner.blurb: A proper night out: good food, a little dress-up, and Kolkata on the plate.

peter-cat.name: Peter Cat
peter-cat.note: Chelo kebab, dim lights, and a Park Street classic.

mocambo.name: Mocambo
mocambo.note: Old-school continental and that late-night Kolkata glow.

oh-calcutta.name: Oh! Calcutta
oh-calcutta.note: Bengali favourites, dressed up for a date night.

6-ballygunge.name: 6 Ballygunge Place
6-ballygunge.note: Home-style Bengali thalis in a heritage bungalow mood.

bohemian.name: Bohemian
bohemian.note: Inventive Bengali plates if you want something special.

arsalan.name: Arsalan
arsalan.note: Biryani, rumali roti, and zero pretence.

kewpies.name: Kewpie's
kewpies.note: Family-run Bengali cooking that always feels like a treat.

travel.name: Traveling Date
travel.blurb: A little escape: river, temple towns, day trips, or just wandering the city.

victoria-maidan.name: Victoria Memorial & Maidan
victoria-maidan.note: Marble, gardens, and a long walk under the Kolkata sky.

prinsep-howrah.name: Prinsep Ghat & Howrah Bridge
prinsep-howrah.note: Sunset on the Hooghly and the city’s most famous skyline.

eco-park.name: Eco Park
eco-park.note: Boats, gardens, and a full afternoon away from traffic.

dakshineswar-belur.name: Dakshineswar & Belur Math
dakshineswar-belur.note: Temples, the river, and a ferry between two banks.

diamond-harbour.name: Diamond Harbour
diamond-harbour.note: A short train ride and the river opening toward the sea.

shantiniketan.name: Shantiniketan day trip
shantiniketan.note: Tagore country: red earth, crafts, and a slower day.

sundarbans.name: Sundarbans (Godkhali start)
sundarbans.note: Mangroves, boats, and a proper adventure if you want a big one.

park.name: Park Date
park.blurb: Grass, shade, ice cream, and time that does not need a reservation.

elliot-park.name: Elliot Park
elliot-park.note: A green pocket right in the middle of the city.

rabindra-sarobar.name: Rabindra Sarobar
rabindra-sarobar.note: Lakeside walking and an easy, unhurried evening.

central-park-salt-lake.name: Central Park
central-park-salt-lake.note: Wide paths, trees, and space to breathe.

agri-horticultural.name: Agri Horticultural Society Garden
agri-horticultural.note: Quiet lawns and flowers when you want something pretty.

riverside.name: Riverside Date
riverside.blurb: The Hooghly at golden hour. That is the whole plan.

prinsep-ghat.name: Prinsep Ghat
prinsep-ghat.note: The postcard sunset: pillars, river, and street musicians.

millennium-park.name: Millennium Park
millennium-park.note: Breeze, benches, and a river cruise if you feel like it.

outram-ghat.name: Outram Ghat
outram-ghat.note: Closer to the bridge lights and the evening crowd.

vidyasagar-setu-view.name: Vidyasagar Setu view
vidyasagar-setu-view.note: Second Hooghly Bridge glittering after dark.

dessert.name: Dessert Date
dessert.blurb: Skip dinner. Go straight to mishti, pastry, and something cold.

nahoums.name: Nahoum's
nahoums.note: Jewish bakery classics in the heart of New Market.

bhim-chandra-nag.name: Bhim Chandra Nag
bhim-chandra-nag.note: Old-school mishti from a legendary kitchen.

paramount.name: Paramount Sherbet
paramount.note: Daab sherbet and a century of College Street summers.

flurys-dessert.name: Flurys (dessert stop)
flurys-dessert.note: Pastry window, rum balls, and a sweet Park Street pause.

culture.name: Culture Date
culture.blurb: Museums, heritage houses, and the Kolkata that lives in stories.

indian-museum.name: Indian Museum
indian-museum.note: The oldest museum in India — plenty to wander through.

victoria-memorial.name: Victoria Memorial
victoria-memorial.note: Galleries inside, gardens outside, photographs everywhere.

jorasanko.name: Jorasanko Thakurbari
jorasanko.note: Tagore’s family home and a slower, storied afternoon.

kumartuli.name: Kumartuli
kumartuli.note: Idol-makers’ lanes — especially magical before Puja.

marble-palace.name: Marble Palace
marble-palace.note: A slightly secret, slightly grand North Kolkata mansion.
